newsitem.title: DENMARK: Rieber open for new Phoenix bid.
newsitem.headline: Rieber open for new Phoenix bid.

text.p: Norway's Rieber and Son said on Friday it did not rule out a possible fresh offer for Danish triple bid target Phoenix Constructors.

After a shareholders' meeting earlier Phoenix declined to recommend a favoured suitor, saying that it would first hold talks with the two highest bidders, Rieber and Denmark's Superfos before making a final recommendation.
Asked if Rieber would consider making a fresh bid for Phoenix, Rieber's company secretary Jan-Olav Strand said to Reuters: "I cannot exclude anything."
In a statement after its meeting Phoenix said that major shareholders were inclined to sell to Superfos if its bid was close to that of competitors.
Rieber started the day as the highest bidder, offering a total of 802 Danish crowns for Phoenix but Superfos then raised the ante to 808 million.
The Norwegians then came back with a counterbid of 740 crowns per A-share and 655 crowns per C-share, totalling 820 million crowns.
The third bidder, Danish building contractor Marius Pedersen said on Thursday that it would not raise its bid of 710 crowns per A-share and 625 crowns per C-share.
Friday's bids extend the offer period under Danish rules until March 7.
